synthesizedFacts.fact: Eczema is a chronic inflammatory skin condition characterized by dry, itchy, and inflamed skin, often cycling through flare-ups and remission.
There is currently no permanent cure for eczema, but it can be effectively managed through skincare, trigger avoidance, and medical treatments.
Moisturization using emollients is a cornerstone of eczema management, helping to retain water and improve skin barrier function.
Topical corticosteroids are commonly used to control itching and inflammation during eczema flare-ups.
Research is ongoing into the use of probiotics to restore the skin microbiome and alleviate eczema symptoms.
